instruction:
In this problem, you are given a Verilog module `niosii_sys_sdram_pll_0` which implements a phase-locked loop (PLL) for generating three clock signals: `ref_clk_clk`, `sys_clk_clk`, and `sdram_clk_clk`. The module also outputs a reset signal `reset_source_reset` which is generated based on the locked status of the PLL. The PLL is implemented using the Altera UP AltPLL IP core and the Altera UP Avalon Reset from Locked Signal IP core.

Your task is to complete the implementation of the `niosii_sys_sdram_pll_0` module by filling in the missing code. Specifically, you need to set the appropriate values for the `OUTCLK0_MULT`, `OUTCLK0_DIV`, `OUTCLK1_MULT`, `OUTCLK1_DIV`, `OUTCLK2_MULT`, and `OUTCLK2_DIV` parameters of the `sys_pll` instance. These parameters control the multiplication and division factors for the PLL output clocks.

You should set the values of these parameters such that the `sys_clk_clk` signal has a frequency of 50 MHz and the `sdram_clk_clk` signal has a frequency of 100 MHz. You should assume that the input clock signal `ref_clk_clk` has a frequency of 50 MHz.

Note that the `sys_pll_locked_export` signal is already correctly connected to the `reset_from_locked` instance, so you do not need to modify this part of the code.
original_rtl:
module niosii_sys_sdram_pll_0 (
		input  wire  ref_clk_clk,        //      ref_clk.clk
		input  wire  ref_reset_reset,    //    ref_reset.reset
		output wire  sys_clk_clk,        //      sys_clk.clk
		output wire  sdram_clk_clk,      //    sdram_clk.clk
		output wire  reset_source_reset  // reset_source.reset
	);

	wire    sys_pll_locked_export; // sys_pll:locked -> reset_from_locked:locked

	altera_up_altpll #(
		.OUTCLK0_MULT  (2),   // multiply ref_clk_clk by 2 to get 100 MHz
		.OUTCLK0_DIV   (1),
		.OUTCLK1_MULT  (1),
		.OUTCLK1_DIV   (1),
		.OUTCLK2_MULT  (1),
		.OUTCLK2_DIV   (1),
		.PHASE_SHIFT   (-3000),
		.DEVICE_FAMILY ("Cyclone IV")
	) sys_pll (
		.refclk  (ref_clk_clk),           //  refclk.clk
		.reset   (ref_reset_reset),       //   reset.reset
		.locked  (sys_pll_locked_export), //  locked.export
		.outclk0 (sdram_clk_clk),         // outclk0.clk
		.outclk1 (sys_clk_clk),           // outclk1.clk
		.outclk2 ()                       // outclk2.clk
	);

	altera_up_avalon_reset_from_locked_signal reset_from_locked (
		.reset  (reset_source_reset),    // reset_source.reset
		.locked (sys_pll_locked_export)  //       locked.export
	);

endmodule
